vibe_and_principles: Objective, rigid, functional, pro-level camera command center.
Banned: Generic purple/teal gradients and soft rounded corners (AI slop).
Focus: Content is king. The interface must fade away so the video preview pops.
Color is for function only: UI is monochrome (Void Black, 10% Grey, stark white), while Action is Signal Red.

headings.usage: Landing page hero, main section titles, massive numbers.

body.usage: General UI text, paragraphs, tooltips, standard buttons.

monospace.usage: Timeline timecodes, credit balances, labels, file metadata.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict geometric containment. Generous negative space in the canvas, extreme density in the control panels.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px-4px). NO large rounded corners.

grids.dashboard: Bento Grid, 'Control Room' mode. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Strict 1px borders between widgets.
grids.editor: h-screen, flex-col. No page scroll. Left sidebar (w-80), Canvas (flex-1), Timeline bottom (h-64).

buttons.primary_cta: bg-[#FF3333] text-white font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#CC0000] transition-colors border border-transparent shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,51,51,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:border-white/60 hover:bg-white/5 font-mono text-xs px-4 py-2 uppercase

canvas_preview.video_wrapper: relative w-full max-h-full aspect-video bg-black ring-1 ring-white/10 shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden

media_urls.description: Cinematic dark video studio equipment setup, perfect for landing page hero background with black/50 overlay.
Dark cubes with glowing lines, ideal for 'Generating Video' state background or AI section.
Professional user avatar for the top navigation bar.
Sample logo texture to be used in UI placeholders if needed.

accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: All interactable elements must have explicit focus states. `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#FF3333] focus-visible:outline-none`
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: Crucial: EVERY button, input, and timeline track must have a `data-testid` attribute. E.g., `data-testid="generate-video-btn"`, `data-testid="prompt-textarea"`.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install Lucide React for icons. Set up Tailwind with the custom colors defined above. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout to maintain the rigid Swiss Brutalist grid.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_overrides: When using Shadcn components (like Slider, Select, Dialog), override default radii to `rounded-sm` and strip shadow-md for flat borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_execution: Start with the Dashboard route (/dashboard) and Editor route (/editor). The Editor MUST be 100vh with no external scrollbar (overflow-hidden on body). Allow scroll only within the left sidebar and timeline areas.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Keep animations instant or very fast (150ms). This is a pro tool, it should feel incredibly responsive, not floaty.
